posts.title: Stop Using TRRS for Split-Keyboard Interconnects!
posts.description: TRRS (Tip Ring Ring Sleeve, or, as you may know it, “headphone jack with microphone support”) cables have long been the go-to connector between split keyboard halves. They are cheap, compact, and thanks to their popularity, come in a variety of aesthetic styles.
